title: Relay - recovery risk workshop
source: Fictional Relay workshop record and supplied chronology
scope: Pilot readiness boundary - recovery and operator use
state: proposed response record; ownership and acceptance unconfirmed
decision_boundary: Whether recovery and operator evidence support the pilot readiness commitment

scale.likelihood_basis: No assessed probability or agreed ordinal likelihood scale was supplied
scale.impact_basis: Acceptance-critical consequences are described directly without invented numeric ratings
scale.score_warning: No score is calculated; a mandatory evidence condition remains priority without a probability estimate
scale.tolerance_source: Relay pilot acceptance boundary in software.md

risks.title: Recovery path may fail under relevant conditions
risks.cause: The actual identity-provider failure scenario and recovery access have not been demonstrated
risks.event: The recovery path does not work when the pilot needs secure restoration
risks.effect: Administrators cannot restore service within the acceptance boundary
risks.evidence: No executed applicable demonstration is supplied
risks.preventive_response: Define the failure scenario and expected audit behavior, then execute an applicable recovery demonstration
risks.owner: Technical performer to confirm; Mina coordinates
risks.trigger: The demonstration fails, cannot be scheduled or does not cover the agreed conditions
risks.contingency: Keep readiness open, investigate and correct, retest, then reassess the date through decision control
risks.note: The imagined outage is a hypothesis, not an observed incident.

risks.title: Operators may not use recovery guidance successfully
risks.cause: Operator access and walkthrough evidence are absent
risks.event: Support cannot complete the required recovery steps
risks.effect: Disruption extends and service restoration remains unverified
risks.existing_control: Support guidance exists in draft form
risks.evidence: No representative operator validation is supplied
risks.preventive_response: Run an operator walkthrough against the actual configuration and capture usability and access findings
risks.owner: Service role and technical performer to confirm
risks.trigger: An operator cannot access, understand or complete a required step
risks.contingency: Revise guidance and access, repeat the walkthrough and retain readiness evidence
risks.note: A technical recovery test alone does not prove operator usability.

events.label: Workshop and readiness cutoff
events.state: Recovery and operator risks remain hypotheses with missing evidence

events.label: Lena rejects readiness
events.state: Missing recovery demonstration is an evidence gap, not proof the imagined outage happened

events.label: Later security acceptance
events.state: Later evidence changes a later snapshot and must not be backdated

presentation.headline: A runbook is not a demonstrated control
presentation.lede: Unknown probability stays visible while recovery and operator evidence drive the response.
presentation.decision: Run the applicable recovery demonstration and operator walkthrough before relying on the readiness claim.

analysis.method: Premortem hypotheses are challenged with current evidence, then linked to a preventive response, trigger, contingency and authority boundary.
analysis.scoring_boundary: No agreed probability-impact scale or assessed values were supplied, so both risks remain in the unknown lane and no score is fabricated.
analysis.authority_boundary: The workshop proposes work and preserves Lena's and Theo's roles; it does not assign the technical performer, approve effort or accept residual exposure.
analysis.review_rule: Revisit on demonstration results, operator findings, confirmed ownership, changed configuration or changed pilot timing.
